basis: Congenital abnormal placement of the female urethral opening; urethra belongs to the renal axis.
Chronic immune-mediated intermediate uveitis affecting the pars plana and vitreous; associated systemic disorders are separate diseases.
Adrenal medullary malignancy defined by metastasis; bone metastases occur in roughly 60-70%, liver 40-50%, and lung 30-40%.
Isolated breaks in Bruch's membrane of the eye; no systemic disease is implied.
Immune-mediated glomerular inflammation in lupus; other systemic lupus manifestations are outside this renal manifestation concept.
Familial hemiplegic migraine is a neurologic disorder characterized by migraine with motor aura.
Congenital cerebral cortical malformation with excessive small gyri and cognitive dysfunction.
Congenital fusion of radius and ulna directly restricts forearm rotation; skeletal abnormalities occur in 80-99%.
Acquired thickening of the skin; heterogeneous causes do not establish a shared infectious or immune mechanism.
Inherited melanin synthesis disorder defined by cutaneous and ocular hypopigmentation; nystagmus and iris abnormalities occur in 30-79%.
Triglyceride storage disorder; myopathy occurs in roughly 50-100% and hepatic disease in about 40-80%, varying by subtype. Ichthyosis and cardiomyopathy are subtype-dependent.
Autoimmune inflammatory muscle disease; dermatomyositis accounts for roughly 80-85% of juvenile cases, with defining inflammatory skin lesions. Lung disease is a minority.
Carcinoma arising in the esophagus with squamous and glandular components.
Pituitary growth hormone excess with defining skeletal and acral overgrowth, reported in 8/12. Visual field defects are occasional; sleep apnea is separately diagnosed.
Congenital anterior segment dysgenesis involving Schwalbe's line, iris and cornea.
Bordetella pertussis infection directly affects respiratory tract epithelium; neurologic complications are uncommon.
Severe juvenile arterial sclerosis directly affects blood vessels; no evidence establishes another commonly damaged organ.
Inherited hypomyelinating leukodystrophy directly affects central nervous system white matter.
Neurodevelopmental impairment defines trisomy 21; congenital heart defects affect ~40-50%, functional eye disorders ~50%, and hearing impairment ~50-75%.
Inherited PRNP prion disease causes spongiform brain degeneration and dementia, present in 9/9; the mechanism involves propagation of infectious prion protein.
Gonadal dysgenesis, retinal dystrophy and myopathy define it; hearing loss 2/3. Cap omits renal agenesis 2/4, hypodontia 4/4 and scaling skin 4/4.
Chronic childhood inflammatory polyarthritis, generally representing immune-mediated juvenile arthritis; no shared extra-articular damage is established.
Neurodevelopmental and hypothalamic-pituitary dysfunction define Prader-Willi syndrome; strabismus and impaired vision occur in 30-79%. Central hypotonia does not establish myopathy.
Severe neurodevelopmental disease with movement abnormalities and seizures; strabismus occurs in 1/2 assessed patients. Hypotonia and spasticity are neurologic.
Developmental impairment, cataracts and skeletal dysplasia define it; dental enamel/eruption defects affect 80-99%. Cap omits hearing loss 30-79% and vocal cord paresis 3/4.
